My rbase map reduce is working fine.  but the way i did is different. I read data from hbase.
And store data in HDFS and then I run map reduce on that.
But it is possible to run map reduce from hbase instead of storing in hdfs.

Here is sample code what i did

>   getdata <- function(x,handle=tb){
    lapply( handle$get(x,what='course:math'),function(r)
 rhuz(r$"course:math"))
   }
> getdata("b")


> rhwrite(getdata("b"), "/home/bikash/builds/test/userhipe/hbase")

> rhls ("/home/bikash/builds/test/userhipe/hbase")

> tmp <- rhread("/home/bikash/builds/test/userhipe/hbase")
RHIPE: Read 1 pair occupying 812 bytes, deserializing


m <- expression({
   lapply(seq_along(map.values), function(r) {
      v <- map.values[[r]]

      k <- map.keys[[r]]
      rhcollect(k, mean(v))
   })
})

r <- expression(
   pre={
      mean <- 0
  
   },
 reduce={
      mean <- max(mean, unlist(reduce.values))
   },
   post={
      rhcollect(reduce.key, mean)
   }
  
)
z <- rhmr(map=m,  reduce=r, ifolder="/home/bikash/builds/test/userhipe/hbase/*",  ofolder="/home/bikash/builds/test/hbase/ex1.2.1",  inout=c("sequence", "sequence"),
    mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=4)
)
rhex(z, async=FALSE)

It is working fine.

But need to find solution to send data directly from rhmr function instead of loading it from ifolder.
It is possible can anyone help me out.
